digest.component_or_area: backend abstraction layer, reconciler inbound path
propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed or returned in production code despite being defined; it exists only in tests and test doubles
RemoteRef.instance field is undocumented and unpopulated in production, blocking observability of deployment identity on inbound reconciliation

vendor field already separates Cloud from DC, but instance cannot prevent local-id collision between two same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives IDs from Jira keys alone, not from instance
Backend port must declare remote_ref() method returning a populated RemoteRef, with instance injected at backend construction time from normalized base URL, not resolved at call time
the docstring claim that instance prevents collision is false and must be corrected in both ADRs 0055 and 0035, with a regression test pinning the known limitation
